records.problem: Switch project npm registry to npmmirror (Taobao) via workspace/.npmrc
records.result_summary: Edit the project file workspace/.npmrc (not ~/.npmrc and not system paths). Set registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com so npm install uses the Taobao npmmirror. Do not change /etc or global npm config.

actions.rationale: Use https://registry.npmmirror.com as the project-level registry URL
